intro: Zjolnir is a Darkspear troll mount breeder stationed in Sen'jin Village along the southern coast of Durotar. He provides trained riding raptors to the Darkspear and trustworthy champions of the Horde. For troll riders, his stable of vicious, loyal beasts is a point of deep cultural pride.

p: Situated near the pens of Sen'jin Village, Zjolnir tends to the fierce raptors favored as mounts by the Darkspear trolls. Raptors are temperamental and predatory by nature, requiring an expert hand to raise and saddle for war. Zjolnir freely provides these prized whistled mounts to fellow trolls who have learned the necessary riding arts. Outsiders belonging to the wider Horde must first earn the exalted trust of the Darkspear tribe before Zjolnir will consider trusting them with one of his pack.
